description: This file defines the TeleSuiteUpdater class, which manages test suite updates, reporting, and error handling within a testing framework, including methods for processing reports and configuring reporters.

classes.name: TeleSuiteUpdater
classes.description: Manages test suite updates, reporting, and error handling, including report processing and reporter configuration.

methods.name: _createReporter
methods.description: Creates a ReporterV2 object with event handlers for test configuration, start, end, and error events.

methods.name: processGlobalReport
methods.description: Processes a global report by dispatching messages to a new TeleReporterReceiver.

methods.name: processListReport
methods.description: Processes a list report, saving current test results and resetting the receiver.

methods.name: processTestReportEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a test report event to the last run receiver and main receiver.

methods.name: _handleOnError
methods.description: Handles errors by recording them and invoking error callbacks.

methods.name: asModel
methods.description: Returns the current state of the updater as a TeleSuiteUpdaterTestModel object.
